theorem_title: The strong bounded-degree barrier alpha_GW + O~(1/d) is exceeded for all degrees d >= 1 on the three-occurrence Horn class
natural_language_statement: Let $\alpha_{\mathrm{GW}}=0.87856$, $\beta^\star=0.94016567$ and $\alpha^*=0.94615981$. Then $\alpha_{\mathrm{GW}}<\beta^\star<\alpha^*<\tfrac{83}{84}<0.9932$. (1) For every rational $a\ge 0.8785$, $1-\frac{1-a}{18}>0.9932$, and for every $d\ge 1$, $1-\frac{1-a}{6d+12}>0.9932$; hence every threshold $\tau\le 0.9932$ is strictly below these ratios. (2) For every $\varepsilon>0$ there is $D$ with $1-\varepsilon<1-\frac{1-a}{6d+12}$ for all $d\ge D$. (3) $0.9326-0.87856=0.05404>0$. (4) If $mc\le m$, $p\le q$ and $p\,mc\le q\,\mathrm{cut}$, then with $B=m(6d+10)$, $\alpha=m+mc$, $s=m+\mathrm{cut}$: $(6d+12)q(B+\alpha)\le(6d+12)q(B+s)+(q-p)(B+\alpha)$, i.e. the lifted ratio is at least $1-\frac{1-p/q}{6d+12}$. (5) $\alpha(H(G))=m+\mathrm{maxcut}(G)$; if $G$ has maximum degree at most $D$ then $H(G)$ has maximum degree at most $D+1$; $2M=4m+2\sum_v\deg(v)^2$ and $4m\le M$ for the number $M$ of edges of $H(G)$; and $4m\le M$, $\alpha\le 2m$, $18785\alpha\le 20000 s$ imply $9932(B+\alpha)\le 10000(B+s)$ for $B=4m+3M$. (6) For a port graph of degree 1 the independence number is $m$ and the optimum of $T_H$ is $3n$; for degree 2, $m=n$ and the optimum is $4n+\alpha$. The value of $\tau_{\mathrm{strong}}(d)=\alpha_{\mathrm{GW}}+\widetilde O(1/d)$, the Goemans--Williamson and Halperin--Livnat--Zwick guarantees, the polynomial running times and the Unique Games hardness statements are cited in the paper and are not formalized.
explanation: Items (1) and (2) are StrongLemmas.lift_gt, regular_gt and tends_one (linarith and div_lt_iff). Item (3) is norm_num. Item (4) is StrongLemmas.cut_lift_ratio (nlinarith). Item (5) combines ConflictGraph.alpha_eq, BoundedLemmas.nbrs_le, edges_ge and ratio_nonregular. Item (6) is RegularLemmas.opt_deg_one and opt_deg_two. The formalization is available at https://github.com/frankvegadelgado/paloma.
definition_title: Port graphs, the formula T_H, edge-list graphs and the conflict graph of F_G
definition_nl: Formal model of the three-occurrence Horn formula T_H of a D-regular graph with a port labelling (PortGraph), its independent sets and independence number, and the number of satisfied clauses (satCount); together with graphs given by an edge list (EdgeGraph), the cut value (cutCount), the literal occurrences of the MAX 2-SAT formula F_G (Occ), the conflict graph on them (Adj, Ind, nbrs, occ) and maximum cut and independence number of the conflict graph (IsMaxCut, IsIndNumber).
